name: photocraft
notes: Runtime pin used by server/install.mjs and the shared installer. Pinned 2026-11-06 to the v0.21.0 release (published 2026-11-06). Digests computed from the downloaded archives and matched against the release's SHA256SUMS.txt; bytes from GitHub asset metadata, matched against the downloads. SHA256SUMS.txt's detached signature (SHA256SUMS.txt.asc) verified with the release-signing-key.asc asset shipped in the same release: ed25519 primary key 2B76741B414AAD6CD33E631213A005C0B9D7C3ED (certify) with signing subkey 568DC1F68F8FAECC797F3C7B006DAF6BB0EF334E (the one SHA256SUMS.txt.asc is made with), asset sha256 8e6925a173d6a7134118da099948de4d9eeec7c1c0770998aec33c9d3f484740, the same bytes the v0.17.1/v0.18.1/v0.20.2 releases shipped; a re-pin compares the key against these values. The installer trusts only this lock's sha256 and bytes. Every archive carries the app and photocraft-cli: since 0.18.0 the macOS DMG bundles the signed CLI at PhotoCraft.app/Contents/MacOS/photocraft-cli, so the separate photocraft-cli zip upstream still publishes for every release (0.21.0 included) is not pinned. Licences: the Windows ZIP and Linux tarball carry LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE and NOTICE; the DMG carries NOTICE (Contents/Resources) and the installer supplements LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE from notices.json, copied from the tagged source and unchanged since v0.20.1. The Linux tarball also ships a bash completion named photocraft-cli, which the installer tells apart from the executable by mode. Exercised at this pin by scripts/extensions/prove-photocraft-drive.ts on darwin-arm64: clean download, size and SHA-256 check, offline tree validation, codesign, headless edits; the drive's window leg (--gui) did not run at this pin. Download only this URL; never select latest at install time.
